#!/bin/bash
# OpenCode Docker wrapper - run from any directory
# Symlink this to ~/bin/oc or add to PATH
#
# Flags:
#   -t, --tmux [image]  Run inside a tmux session named after the current directory.
#                       Optionally accepts a Docker image reference to use instead of
#                       the default image (e.g. `oc -t myrepo/myimage:tag`).
#   -u, --usb           Interactively select one or more USB devices to pass through
#                       into the container via --device.

USE_TMUX=false
CUSTOM_IMAGE=""
USB_DEVICES=()

# Interactively pick USB devices from lsusb output.
# Populates the USB_DEVICES array with /dev/bus/usb/<bus>/<dev> paths.
select_usb_devices() {
    if ! command -v lsusb &>/dev/null; then
        echo "Error: lsusb not found. Install usbutils to use --usb." >&2
        exit 1
    fi

    # Build a list: "Bus 005 Device 002: ID 0b48:2003 TechnoTrend AG TT-USB..."
    local usb_list
    usb_list=$(lsusb) || { echo "Error: lsusb failed." >&2; exit 1; }

    if [ -z "$usb_list" ]; then
        echo "No USB devices found." >&2
        exit 1
    fi

    local selected
    if command -v fzf &>/dev/null; then
        # Multi-select with fzf
        selected=$(echo "$usb_list" | fzf --multi --prompt="Select USB device(s) > " \
            --header="TAB to multi-select, ENTER to confirm, ESC to cancel")
    else
        # Fallback: numbered menu
        local lines=()
        while IFS= read -r line; do
            lines+=("$line")
        done <<< "$usb_list"

        echo "Available USB devices:" >&2
        for i in "${!lines[@]}"; do
            printf "  [%d] %s\n" "$((i+1))" "${lines[$i]}" >&2
        done
        echo >&2
        printf "Enter device number(s) separated by spaces: " >&2
        read -r choices
        for c in $choices; do
            if [[ "$c" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && [ "$c" -ge 1 ] && [ "$c" -le "${#lines[@]}" ]; then
                selected+="${lines[$((c-1))]}"$'\n'
            else
                echo "Warning: invalid selection '$c' ignored." >&2
            fi
        done
    fi

    if [ -z "$selected" ]; then
        echo "No device selected." >&2
        exit 1
    fi

    # Parse selected lines into /dev/bus/usb/<bus>/<device> paths
    while IFS= read -r line; do
        [ -z "$line" ] && continue
        # Format: "Bus NNN Device NNN: ID ..."
        local bus dev
        bus=$(echo "$line" | sed -n 's/^Bus \([0-9]\+\) .*/\1/p')
        dev=$(echo "$line"  | sed -n 's/^Bus [0-9]\+ Device \([0-9]\+\):.*/\1/p')
        if [ -z "$bus" ] || [ -z "$dev" ]; then
            echo "Warning: could not parse bus/device from: $line" >&2
            continue
        fi
        local dev_path="/dev/bus/usb/${bus}/${dev}"
        if [ ! -e "$dev_path" ]; then
            echo "Warning: device path $dev_path does not exist on host." >&2
            continue
        fi
        USB_DEVICES+=("$dev_path")
    done <<< "$selected"

    if [ ${#USB_DEVICES[@]} -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "Error: no valid USB device paths resolved." >&2
        exit 1
    fi

# Parse flags
while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    case "$1" in
        -t|--tmux)
            USE_TMUX=true
            shift
            # If the next argument looks like a Docker image reference (not a flag),
            # consume it as the custom image name.
            if [[ $# -gt 0 && "$1" != -* ]]; then
                CUSTOM_IMAGE="$1"
                shift
            fi
            ;;
        -u|--usb)
            select_usb_devices
            shift
            ;;
        --)
            shift
            break
            ;;
        *)
            break
            ;;
    esac

# re-exec this script (without -t) inside a new/existing tmux session.
if [ "${USE_TMUX}" = true ]; then
    TMUX_SESSION=$(basename "$(pwd)" | tr '.' '_')
    SELF="$(readlink -f "$0")"

    if [ -n "${TMUX}" ]; then
        # Already inside tmux — check if it's the right session
        CURRENT_SESSION=$(tmux display-message -p '#S')
        if [ "${CURRENT_SESSION}" = "${TMUX_SESSION}" ]; then
            # Already in the target session, just run oc normally (pass image if set)
            if [ -n "${CUSTOM_IMAGE}" ]; then
                exec "${SELF}" --image "${CUSTOM_IMAGE}" "$@"
            else
                exec "${SELF}" "$@"
            fi
        fi
    fi

    # Launch or attach to the tmux session, running oc inside it
    if [ -n "${CUSTOM_IMAGE}" ]; then
        exec tmux new-session -A -s "${TMUX_SESSION}" "${SELF}" --image "${CUSTOM_IMAGE}" "$@"
    else
        exec tmux new-session -A -s "${TMUX_SESSION}" "${SELF}" "$@"
    fi
fi

# Internal flag --image: passes a custom Docker image reference when re-execing
# from within the tmux branch above. Users may also call it directly.
if [[ $# -gt 0 && "$1" == "--image" ]]; then
    CUSTOM_IMAGE="$2"
    shift 2
fi

IMAGE_NAME="${CUSTOM_IMAGE:-mheers/opencode-sandbox:latest}"
# Generate unique container name based on current directory
DIR_HASH=$(echo "$(pwd)" | md5sum | cut -c1-8)
CONTAINER_NAME="opencode-${DIR_HASH}"
LOCAL_VOLUME="opencode-local-${DIR_HASH}"
USER_ID=$(id -u)
GROUP_ID=$(id -g)

GPG_SOCKET_DIR="${RUNTIME_DIR}/gnupg"
GPG_SOCKET_MOUNT=""
GPG_TTY_ENV=""
SSH_AUTH_MOUNT=""
SSH_AUTH_ENV=""
DOCKER_GID=""
DOCKER_GROUP_ADD=""
KVM_GID=""
KVM_GROUP_ADD=""
KVM_DEVICE=""
USB_DEVICE_ARGS=()
GITCONFIG_MOUNT=""
GITCONFIG_PATH="/home/user/.gitconfig.host"
DBUS_MOUNT=""
DBUS_ENV=""
PIPEWIRE_MOUNT=""
PIPEWIRE_ENV=""

if [ -S "${GPG_SOCKET_DIR}/S.gpg-agent" ]; then
    GPG_SOCKET_MOUNT="-v ${GPG_SOCKET_DIR}:${GPG_SOCKET_DIR} -v ${GPG_SOCKET_DIR}/S.gpg-agent:/home/user/.gnupg/S.gpg-agent"
    GPG_TTY_ENV="-e GPG_TTY=$(tty)"

if [ -S "${SSH_AUTH_SOCK}" ]; then
    SSH_AUTH_MOUNT="-v ${SSH_AUTH_SOCK}:/ssh-agent"
    SSH_AUTH_ENV="-e SSH_AUTH_SOCK=/ssh-agent"

if [ -z "${SSH_AUTH_SOCK}" ] && [ -S "${GPG_SOCKET_DIR}/S.gpg-agent.ssh" ]; then
    if [ -z "${GPG_SOCKET_MOUNT}" ]; then
        GPG_SOCKET_MOUNT="-v ${GPG_SOCKET_DIR}:${GPG_SOCKET_DIR}"
    fi
    SSH_AUTH_ENV="-e SSH_AUTH_SOCK=${GPG_SOCKET_DIR}/S.gpg-agent.ssh"

    DOCKER_GID=$(stat -c '%g' /var/run/docker.sock)
    DOCKER_GROUP_ADD="--group-add ${DOCKER_GID}"

    KVM_GROUP_ADD="--group-add ${KVM_GID}"
    KVM_DEVICE="--device /dev/kvm"

# Build --device flags for any USB devices selected via -u/--usb
for usb_path in "${USB_DEVICES[@]}"; do

# OpenCode Docker wrapper - run from any directory
# Symlink this to ~/bin/oc or add to PATH
#
# Flags:
#   -t, --tmux [image]  Run inside a tmux session named after the current directory.
#                       Optionally accepts a Docker image reference to use instead of
#                       the default image (e.g. `oc -t myrepo/myimage:tag`).
#   -u, --usb           Interactively select one or more USB devices to pass through
#                       into the container via --device.

USE_TMUX=false
CUSTOM_IMAGE=""
USB_DEVICES=()

# Interactively pick USB devices from lsusb output.
# Populates the USB_DEVICES array with /dev/bus/usb/<bus>/<dev> paths.
select_usb_devices() {
    if ! command -v lsusb &>/dev/null; then
        echo "Error: lsusb not found. Install usbutils to use --usb." >&2
        exit 1
    fi

    # Build a list: "Bus 005 Device 002: ID 0b48:2003 TechnoTrend AG TT-USB..."
    local usb_list
    usb_list=$(lsusb) || { echo "Error: lsusb failed." >&2; exit 1; }

    if [ -z "$usb_list" ]; then
        echo "No USB devices found." >&2
        exit 1
    fi

    local selected
    if command -v fzf &>/dev/null; then
        # Multi-select with fzf
        selected=$(echo "$usb_list" | fzf --multi --prompt="Select USB device(s) > " \
            --header="TAB to multi-select, ENTER to confirm, ESC to cancel")
    else
        # Fallback: numbered menu
        local lines=()
        while IFS= read -r line; do
            lines+=("$line")
        done <<< "$usb_list"

        echo "Available USB devices:" >&2
        for i in "${!lines[@]}"; do
            printf "  [%d] %s\n" "$((i+1))" "${lines[$i]}" >&2
        done
        echo >&2
        printf "Enter device number(s) separated by spaces: " >&2
        read -r choices
        for c in $choices; do
            if [[ "$c" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && [ "$c" -ge 1 ] && [ "$c" -le "${#lines[@]}" ]; then
                selected+="${lines[$((c-1))]}"$'\n'
            else
                echo "Warning: invalid selection '$c' ignored." >&2
            fi
        done
    fi

    if [ -z "$selected" ]; then
        echo "No device selected." >&2
        exit 1
    fi

    # Parse selected lines into /dev/bus/usb/<bus>/<device> paths
    while IFS= read -r line; do
        [ -z "$line" ] && continue
        # Format: "Bus NNN Device NNN: ID ..."
        local bus dev
        bus=$(echo "$line" | sed -n 's/^Bus \([0-9]\+\) .*/\1/p')
        dev=$(echo "$line"  | sed -n 's/^Bus [0-9]\+ Device \([0-9]\+\):.*/\1/p')
        if [ -z "$bus" ] || [ -z "$dev" ]; then
            echo "Warning: could not parse bus/device from: $line" >&2
            continue
        fi
        local dev_path
        dev_path="/dev/bus/usb/$(printf '%03d' "$bus")/$(printf '%03d' "$dev")"
        if [ ! -e "$dev_path" ]; then
            echo "Warning: device path $dev_path does not exist on host." >&2
            continue
        fi
        USB_DEVICES+=("$dev_path")
    done <<< "$selected"

    if [ ${#USB_DEVICES[@]} -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "Error: no valid USB device paths resolved." >&2
        exit 1
    fi
}

# Parse flags
while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    case "$1" in
        -t|--tmux)
            USE_TMUX=true
            shift
            # If the next argument looks like a Docker image reference (not a flag),
            # consume it as the custom image name.
            if [[ $# -gt 0 && "$1" != -* ]]; then
                CUSTOM_IMAGE="$1"
                shift
            fi
            ;;
        -u|--usb)
            select_usb_devices
            shift
            ;;
        --)
            shift
            break
            ;;
        *)
            break
            ;;
    esac
done

# If --tmux requested and we're not already inside the target session,
# re-exec this script (without -t) inside a new/existing tmux session.
if [ "${USE_TMUX}" = true ]; then
    TMUX_SESSION=$(basename "$(pwd)" | tr '.' '_')
    SELF="$(readlink -f "$0")"

    if [ -n "${TMUX}" ]; then
        # Already inside tmux — check if it's the right session
        CURRENT_SESSION=$(tmux display-message -p '#S')
        if [ "${CURRENT_SESSION}" = "${TMUX_SESSION}" ]; then
            # Already in the target session, just run oc normally (pass image if set)
            if [ -n "${CUSTOM_IMAGE}" ]; then
                exec "${SELF}" --image "${CUSTOM_IMAGE}" "$@"
            else
                exec "${SELF}" "$@"
            fi
        fi
    fi

    # Launch or attach to the tmux session, running oc inside it
    if [ -n "${CUSTOM_IMAGE}" ]; then
        exec tmux new-session -A -s "${TMUX_SESSION}" "${SELF}" --image "${CUSTOM_IMAGE}" "$@"
    else
        exec tmux new-session -A -s "${TMUX_SESSION}" "${SELF}" "$@"
    fi
fi

# Internal flag --image: passes a custom Docker image reference when re-execing
# from within the tmux branch above. Users may also call it directly.
if [[ $# -gt 0 && "$1" == "--image" ]]; then
    CUSTOM_IMAGE="$2"
    shift 2
fi

IMAGE_NAME="${CUSTOM_IMAGE:-mheers/opencode-sandbox:latest}"
# Generate unique container name based on current directory
DIR_HASH=$(echo "$(pwd)" | md5sum | cut -c1-8)
CONTAINER_NAME="opencode-${DIR_HASH}"
LOCAL_VOLUME="opencode-local-${DIR_HASH}"
USER_ID=$(id -u)
GROUP_ID=$(id -g)
RUNTIME_DIR="/run/user/${USER_ID}"
GPG_SOCKET_DIR="${RUNTIME_DIR}/gnupg"
GPG_SOCKET_MOUNT=""
GPG_TTY_ENV=""
SSH_AUTH_MOUNT=""
SSH_AUTH_ENV=""
DOCKER_GID=""
DOCKER_GROUP_ADD=""
KVM_GID=""
KVM_GROUP_ADD=""
KVM_DEVICE=""
USB_DEVICE_ARGS=()
USB_CAP_MKNOD=""
GITCONFIG_MOUNT=""
GITCONFIG_PATH="/home/user/.gitconfig.host"
DBUS_MOUNT=""
DBUS_ENV=""
PIPEWIRE_MOUNT=""
PIPEWIRE_ENV=""

if [ -S "${GPG_SOCKET_DIR}/S.gpg-agent" ]; then
    GPG_SOCKET_MOUNT="-v ${GPG_SOCKET_DIR}:${GPG_SOCKET_DIR} -v ${GPG_SOCKET_DIR}/S.gpg-agent:/home/user/.gnupg/S.gpg-agent"
    GPG_TTY_ENV="-e GPG_TTY=$(tty)"
fi

if [ -S "${SSH_AUTH_SOCK}" ]; then
    SSH_AUTH_MOUNT="-v ${SSH_AUTH_SOCK}:/ssh-agent"
    SSH_AUTH_ENV="-e SSH_AUTH_SOCK=/ssh-agent"
fi

if [ -z "${SSH_AUTH_SOCK}" ] && [ -S "${GPG_SOCKET_DIR}/S.gpg-agent.ssh" ]; then
    if [ -z "${GPG_SOCKET_MOUNT}" ]; then
        GPG_SOCKET_MOUNT="-v ${GPG_SOCKET_DIR}:${GPG_SOCKET_DIR}"
    fi
    SSH_AUTH_ENV="-e SSH_AUTH_SOCK=${GPG_SOCKET_DIR}/S.gpg-agent.ssh"
fi

if [ -S /var/run/docker.sock ]; then
    DOCKER_GID=$(stat -c '%g' /var/run/docker.sock)
    DOCKER_GROUP_ADD="--group-add ${DOCKER_GID}"
fi

if [ -e /dev/kvm ]; then
    KVM_GID=$(stat -c '%g' /dev/kvm)
    KVM_GROUP_ADD="--group-add ${KVM_GID}"
    KVM_DEVICE="--device /dev/kvm"
fi

# Build --device flags for any USB devices selected via -u/--usb
for usb_path in "${USB_DEVICES[@]}"; do
    USB_DEVICE_ARGS+=("--device" "${usb_path}:${usb_path}")
done
if [ ${#USB_DEVICE_ARGS[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
    USB_CAP_MKNOD="--cap-add CAP_MKNOD"
fi

if [ -f "$(pwd)/.gitconfig.oc" ]; then
    GITCONFIG_MOUNT="-v $(pwd)/.gitconfig.oc:/home/user/.gitconfig:ro"
    GITCONFIG_PATH="/home/user/.gitconfig"
fi

# Forward host D-Bus session so libnotify (notify-send) works inside the container
if [ -n "${DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS}" ]; then
    DBUS_SOCKET=$(echo "${DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS}" | sed 's|unix:path=||')
    if [ -S "${DBUS_SOCKET}" ]; then
        DBUS_MOUNT="-v ${DBUS_SOCKET}:${DBUS_SOCKET}"
        DBUS_ENV="-e DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS=${DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS}"
    fi
fi

# Forward host PipeWire-PulseAudio socket so paplay can play sounds inside the container
# pipewire-pulse creates a PulseAudio-compatible socket at pulse/native;
# paplay cannot use the native pipewire-0 socket directly.
PULSE_NATIVE_SOCKET="${RUNTIME_DIR}/pulse/native"
PULSE_NATIVE_DIR="${RUNTIME_DIR}/pulse"
if [ -S "${PULSE_NATIVE_SOCKET}" ]; then
    PIPEWIRE_MOUNT="-v ${PULSE_NATIVE_DIR}:${PULSE_NATIVE_DIR}"
    PIPEWIRE_ENV="-e PULSE_SERVER=unix:${PULSE_NATIVE_SOCKET}"
elif [ -S "${RUNTIME_DIR}/pipewire-0" ]; then
    # Fallback: mount the native PipeWire socket (less compatible with paplay)
    PIPEWIRE_MOUNT="-v ${RUNTIME_DIR}/pipewire-0:${RUNTIME_DIR}/pipewire-0"
    PIPEWIRE_ENV="-e PULSE_SERVER=unix:${RUNTIME_DIR}/pipewire-0"
fi


# Check if container already exists and is running
if docker ps -q -f name="^${CONTAINER_NAME}$" | grep -q .; then
    echo "Container ${CONTAINER_NAME} already running, attaching..."
    docker exec -it "${CONTAINER_NAME}" /usr/bin/zsh -i "$@"
    exit $?
fi

# Check if container exists but is stopped
if docker ps -aq -f name="^${CONTAINER_NAME}$" | grep -q .; then
    echo "Starting existing container ${CONTAINER_NAME}..."
    docker start "${CONTAINER_NAME}"
    docker exec -it "${CONTAINER_NAME}" /usr/bin/zsh -i "$@"
    exit $?
fi

docker run -it --rm \
    --name "${CONTAINER_NAME}" \
    --network host \
    --user "${USER_ID}:${GROUP_ID}" \
    -e HOME=/home/user \
    -e PATH=/home/user/.opencode/bin:/home/user/.bun/bin:/home/user/.ocx/bin:/home/user/bin:/home/user/.local/bin:/home/user/go/bin:/usr/local/go/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin \
    -v "$(pwd)":/home/user/project \
    -v "${HOME}/.opencode:/home/user/.opencode" \
    -v "${HOME}/.config/opencode:/home/user/.config/opencode" \
    -v "${LOCAL_VOLUME}:/home/user/.local" \
    -v "${HOME}/.local/share/opencode:/home/user/.local/share/opencode" \
    --tmpfs /home/user/.local/state:uid="${USER_ID}",gid="${GROUP_ID}",mode=700 \
    -v "${HOME}/.local/state/opencode:/home/user/.local/state/opencode" \
    -e AGENT_BROWSER_SOCKET_DIR=/home/user/.local/state/agent-browser \
    -e AGENT_BROWSER_HOME=/opt/agent-browser \
    -v "${HOME}/.gitconfig:/home/user/.gitconfig.host:ro" \
    ${GITCONFIG_MOUNT} \
    -v "${HOME}/.gnupg:/home/user/.gnupg" \
    -v "${HOME}/.ssh:/home/user/.ssh:ro" \
    -v "/var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock" \
    ${GPG_SOCKET_MOUNT} \
    ${SSH_AUTH_MOUNT} \
    --tmpfs /home/user/.cache:uid="${USER_ID}",gid="${GROUP_ID}",mode=700 \
    -v "${HOME}/.cache/ms-playwright:/home/user/.cache/ms-playwright" \
    -v "${HOME}/.cache/opencode:/home/user/.cache/opencode" \
    -v "${HOME}/.bun/install/cache:/home/user/.bun/install/cache" \
    -w /home/user/project \
    ${DOCKER_GROUP_ADD} \
    ${KVM_GROUP_ADD} \
    ${KVM_DEVICE} \
    "${USB_DEVICE_ARGS[@]}" \
    ${USB_CAP_MKNOD} \
    -e GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL="${GITCONFIG_PATH}" \
    --entrypoint /usr/local/bin/entrypoint.sh \
    ${GPG_TTY_ENV} \
    ${SSH_AUTH_ENV} \
    ${DBUS_MOUNT} \
    ${DBUS_ENV} \
    ${PIPEWIRE_MOUNT} \
    ${PIPEWIRE_ENV} \
    "${IMAGE_NAME}" /usr/bin/zsh -i "$@"

parts.text: `lsusb` reports `Bus 005 Device 002` but sed was stripping the leading zeros, producing `/dev/bus/usb/5/2` instead of `/dev/bus/usb/005/002`. The `printf '%03d'` ensures both bus and device numbers are always 3-digit zero-padded to match the kernel's `/dev/bus/usb/` layout.
